boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces for studying, meeting, relaxing, gaming, and campus activities.

cards.entity_name: Dennis ’72 and Denise Tepas Commons & Terrace
cards.title: Set up a group-project huddle at Tepas Commons
cards.subtitle: Donald E. Bain Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the booths or tables for a group project, then step onto the adjacent terrace for outdoor seating by the Keough Quad.
cards.short_summary: Indoor commons seating connects directly to an outdoor terrace.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons has booths, tables, TVs with AirPlay in some booths for collaborative work, and an adjoining terrace with gathering seating.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Campus Center; the University states the Campus Center is open 24/7.

cards.title: Meet your club team in The Nest
cards.subtitle: First floor, Donald E. Bain Campus Center
cards.notes: Bring a club task or independent work between classes; community workspaces and soft seating support both short stops and evening meetings.
cards.short_summary: Club-organization hub and commuter lounge with shared work areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nest houses student-organization offices, and all students may use its community workspaces and soft furniture for work, rest, or club meetings.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: First floor of the Campus Center; the University states the Campus Center is open 24/7.

cards.title: Use the COP Room for a focused study session
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Donald E. Bain Campus Center
cards.notes: Choose this midsize room when you need a computer, projector, or teaching station; check whether a campus reservation is already using it.
cards.short_summary: A campus-center multipurpose room with presentation equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The COP Room has a teaching station, computer, and projector; it is used for studying and campus events and may be reserved by University departments or clubs.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Second floor of the Campus Center; availability can be affected by reservations.

cards.title: Plan a small presentation in the Formal Lounge
cards.subtitle: First floor, Donald E. Bain Campus Center
cards.notes: Use its computer and projector for a meeting or presentation when open; confirm whether a University department or club has reserved it.
cards.short_summary: First-floor multipurpose lounge equipped for presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elaine Wilson Formal Lounge is a midsize multipurpose room with a computer and projector and may be reserved by University departments or clubs.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: First floor across from the Office of Safety and Security; availability can be affected by reservations.

cards.title: Take a game break in Michaelhouse
cards.subtitle: Outside SONO Latin Grill, Michaelhouse
cards.notes: Gather around the billiards tables, ping-pong table, arcade game, or couches; this main area does not require ID-card access.
cards.short_summary: A casual recreation area beside SONO Latin Grill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michaelhouse main area has ping pong, an arcade game, billiards, cable television, and couches; Fisher students may use its games during and outside SONO Latin Grill hours.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: The University states this area does not require ID-card access; game use is for Fisher students.

cards.title: Reserve an evening for the Gaming Lab
cards.subtitle: Michaelhouse
cards.notes: Bring your student ID for card-swipe entry and use a gaming station with friends; board and card games are also available in the room.
cards.short_summary: Card-swipe gaming space with 15 stations and tabletop games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gaming Lab has 15 gaming stations plus board and card games, and students may use it for individual or group gaming.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: All students and employees have card-swipe access.

cards.title: Find a dance-club practice in Murphy Hall
cards.subtitle: Across from Murphy Dining Hall
cards.notes: Look for dance, Irish dance, or Cardinal Company activity here, and contact the relevant club if you want to join a practice.
cards.short_summary: Club-used dance studio in Murphy Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dance Studio is used by dance club, Irish dance club, and Cardinal Company; the University says all clubs welcome new members.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Located across from Murphy Dining Hall; participation and room access depend on club activity.

cards.title: Use the 24/7 Study Hall when you need a desk
cards.subtitle: North side of Lavery Library, along LeChase Commons
cards.notes: Use the hallway seating or computers for individual work, and keep the route clear when informational tabling or events are scheduled.
cards.short_summary: After-hours study hallway with seating and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: The 24/7 Study Hall is outside Lavery’s second-floor entrances on the LeChase Commons side and includes seating and computers for Fisher student use.
cards.access_notes: The University identifies it as a 24/7 Study Hall for Fisher student use; it may also host tabling or informational events.

cards.title: Settle into D'Amico Silent Study for quiet reading
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Lavery Library
cards.notes: Choose this designated silent-study area when you need concentrated reading or writing; use a different library space for conversation or group work.
cards.short_summary: Named third-floor silent-study destination in Lavery Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library’s third floor includes the John S. D'Amico Silent Study, along with whisper study and group and individual study rooms.
cards.source_title: Lavery Library Maps | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Third-floor library space; follow the library’s designated noise expectations.

cards.entity_name: Fr. Joseph A. Trovato, CSB Campus Ministry Center
cards.title: Use the Trovato Center for a quiet group check-in
cards.subtitle: First floor, Donald E. Bain Campus Center
cards.notes: Stop by the lounge or interfaith prayer space to study with friends, talk with Campus Ministry, or take a quieter pause between commitments.
cards.short_summary: Campus Ministry gathering space with a lounge and interfaith room.
cards.evidence_claim: The Trovato Campus Ministry Center serves as a gathering place to lounge, study with friends, speak with a campus minister, or use its interfaith room.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry Locations | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: First floor of the Campus Center; the University describes Campus Ministry as welcoming students of all faith traditions.
